owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: The convergence engine merges one note against a base today. Before it can touch projects, tasks, decisions or evidence, every entity type needs a declared merge class (last-writer, set union, append-only, human resolution) and an authority owner. The re-derivation of state from events is SO-07-A AC03 and the version conflict is SO-04-A AC06; this contract adds the schema and the semantic part those do not catch. The core applies no merge class itself: the free path keeps both versions and the engine contract is SO-F-06 (the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs, ADR 6).

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.

Stop when the work would implement a federation, replication, trust, admission or computation feature beyond the specification, schema, validator and conformance test the contract names; the product keeps the planned label on it.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

title: SO-F-02 Canonical project schema, version 1, with authority and merge classes: every entity type declares its owner authority, scope version and merge class, and two incompatible approvals derive to a semantic conflict, never to an applied state
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-02) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-1.07 (Relationship model: explicit relations between project items, and change propagation that marks affected work stale); SO-2.01 (Organisational knowledge model: relationships between people, teams, projects, decisions, artefacts and evidence) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-04-A†, SO-07-A†, WO-05-A†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-01, SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.7 (convergence of state is not proof of truth; the event, receipt and evidence model) and #223 ARCHITECTURAL-INTERDEPENDENCIES.md (structured state convergence requires canonical schemas, ownership and conflict policy). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Prerequisite SO-1.01 added: the state machine and store are now wired, so the semantic-conflict rule acts on the real transition table. (4) Boundary with PG-05.1 WP05-01 (merge-semantics table by object class, docs/MERGE-SEMANTICS.md): the vocabulary of semantics is owned there. This contract owns the declaration on every entity type, the store refusing an entity without one, and the semantic-conflict rule. The four class names in the schema must equal the semantics column of that table; neither contract redefines the other.
